fixed_message_rule: CausalRelay, Uniform, Head, FullContext and local compressor outputs are frozen per source/budget before receiver evaluation. Any query-aware comparator sees only the same global downstream task.
primary_training_rule: CausalRelay utility predictor is trained once on primary-preview-model Development labels, then frozen. The same learned source-only policy is evaluated across robustness receiver rows. Robustness rows do not reselect the predictor family.
vanilla_rule: VanillaRelay is generated separately by each model row.
